follow-up time: Through pregnancy and delivery, with some postpartum follow-up
exposure: Women with GDM and different maternal characteristics (BMI, weight gain, nationality, family history of diabetes, previous diabetes-related pregnancy complications)
outcome: Adverse birth outcomes (e.g., macrosomia, fetal death)
finding: Several maternal factors, including initial BMI, weight gain, nationality, and family history of diabetes, were associated with increased risk of complications in women with GDM.
mod_finding: This study of gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) found that cesarean section rates were 21.8%.
